_comment: Copy this to sources.json beside the script and edit the folders. The key is not in
here on purpose — it lives in the METRIQ_INGEST_KEY environment variable.
location   one of: toronto, new-jersey, nashville, springfield, chicago
folder     any path this account can already open — a mapped drive, a UNC path, or a
match      a wildcard, not a regular expression
dateFrom   'modified' (the file's own date), 'filename' (a date in the name), or
'today' — which morning the numbers are read for
newestOnly true sends only the most recent match; false sends every match, which is
what a folder of daily exports wants
enabled    set false to leave a source configured but idle
